root.title: gamble-core routine configuration
root.description: GENERATED from config/knobs.json by tools/gen_config.py. Field names are the environment variable names entrypoint.sh reads.

TASK.title: Workflow / Task
TASK.description: Workflow / Task -- Which workflow to run. A default set here is NOT enough: the platform must pass the value into the container, as a command argument or in the environment. The run log names the source it arrived from.

GAMBLE_WORK_DIR.title: Mounted drive  [count, flat, gate, nested, project, recover]
GAMBLE_WORK_DIR.description: Mounted drive  [count, flat, gate, nested, project, recover] -- The FUSE mount where outputs and results are symlinked so the platform collects them.

RUN_ID.title: Run identifier / tag  [count, flat, gate, nested, project]
RUN_ID.description: Run identifier / tag  [count, flat, gate, nested, project] -- Tag appended to output directories to isolate runs (e.g. 'run1', 'exp_v2'). 'auto' uses the cluster job ID or timestamp.

NITER.title: Total sweeps (burn-in + kept)  [count, flat, gate, nested, project]
NITER.description: Total sweeps (burn-in + kept)  [count, flat, gate, nested, project] -- TOTAL sweeps, burn-in included. 'auto' uses the validated preset default (e.g. 5000 for BMLEH production). Set a number for a custom sampler run.

N_CHAINS.title: Chains  [count, flat, gate, nested, project]
N_CHAINS.description: Chains  [count, flat, gate, nested, project] -- Chains fitted in parallel; 'auto' uses the preset default (e.g. 4 for BMLEH production, 1 for smoke). Set a number for custom multi-chain runs.

EXTRA.title: Overrides
EXTRA.description: Overrides -- one-off settings as KEY=VALUE, comma separated, e.g. 'NITER=8000, USE_BART=TRUE'. Applied on top of the profile, and rejected if a key is not a declared knob. 'none' for no overrides.
